name: Athaliah
bio:
Athaliah, daughter of Omri, king of Israel (and so a daughter of Ahab's house), married Jehoram, king of Judah, and became the mother of Ahaziah, who succeeded his father as king of Judah (2 Kings 8:18, 26). Her marriage drew Judah's royal house into the ways and idolatry of Ahab's dynasty.

## 📖 Core Story: Seizing the Throne, and a Six-Year Reign Ended

When her son Ahaziah died, Athaliah moved immediately to destroy the entire royal line of Judah and seize the throne for herself. She failed to kill one grandson, Joash, whom his aunt Jehosheba stole away and hid in the temple with his nurse. Athaliah then reigned over Judah for six years while the boy remained hidden (2 Kings 11:1-3).

In the seventh year, the priest Jehoiada organized the temple guard, armed them with David's old weapons, and crowned Joash king inside the temple. Hearing the commotion, Athaliah rushed in and found the boy already crowned and the people celebrating; she tore her clothes and cried "Treason, Treason," but Jehoiada had her taken outside the temple grounds and put to death, ending her usurpation (2 Kings 11:4-16, 20).
